title: Experiment E13 — Controlled DDoS-like Runtime Validation Preregistration
scientific_goal: Distinguish workload representativeness/distribution shift (H1) from RF-v3 Normal/DDoS decision-boundary sensitivity reduction (H2), without a causal conclusion absent results.

E13-D2-R1.purpose: Higher-concurrency bounded controlled multi-source DDoS-like profile

terminology: D1/D2 are controlled multi-source DDoS-like traffic from logical source identities on one physical VM; neither is a real DDoS nor a distributed attacker fleet.

analysis_plan.profile_labels: experiment-level only; later report scoped detection rate, not universal DDoS recall

decision_logic.A: D2 closer to frozen DDoS and RF-v3 detects more DDoS-like flows: supports H1.
decision_logic.B: D1/D2 closer but RF-v3 remains Normal while RF-v2 detects DDoS: strengthens H2.
decision_logic.C: Both models fail despite closeness: may indicate broader lab-vs-training mismatch.
decision_logic.D: Neither profile approaches frozen DDoS: workload remains insufficient.

next_operator_gate: A separate operator authorization must verify topology, target, capture interface, bounded command arguments, model/contract hashes, and empty dedicated evidence directories immediately before any execution.
